source.body: ## Describe the problem/error/question When creating or updating the SSH/SFTP Connection Port in a credential (for example, setting it to `100222`), the interface misbehaves in two ways: 1. The field validation claims the value is missing/empty even though a value has been entered, or it simply erases/clears the value automatically upon saving or switching fields. 2. The UI incorrectly formats large port numbers by automatically adding a thousand separator comma (e.g., displaying `100222` as `100,222`), treating a network port number like a standard formatted integer. ## What is the error message (if any)? This field is required [Open docs](https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/builtin/credentials/ftp/?utm_source=n8n_app&utm_medium=credential_settings&utm_campaign=create_new_credentials_modal) ## Please share your workflow/screenshots/recording ``` (Select the nodes on your canvas and use the keyboard shortcuts CMD+C/CTRL+C and CMD+V/CTRL+V to copy and paste the workflow.) ⚠️ WARNING ⚠️ If you have sensitive data in your workflow (like API keys), please remove it before sharing. ``` ## Share the output returned by the last node ## Debug info ### core - n8nVersion: 2.38.7 - platform: docker (self-hosted) - nodeJsVersion: 26.7.0 - nodeEnv: production - database: postgres - executionMode: regular - concurrency: -1 - license: enterprise (production) ### storage - success: all - error: all - progress: false - manual: true - binaryMode: filesystem ### pruning - enabled: true - maxAge: 336 hours - maxCount: 10000 executions ### client - userAgent: mozilla/5.0 (windows nt 10.0; win64; x64) applewebkit/537.36 (khtml, like gecko) chrome/155.0.0.0 safari/537.36 - isTouchDevice: false Generated at: 2026-10-15T17:51:06.667Z

comments.author: WilliamAyad
comments.text:
This is the same credential-form bug as #40803, which the team already fixed —
per the maintainer there, upgrade to n8n 2.39.7 or later and re-enter the port;
the original reporter confirmed the form works after upgrading. If it still
clears the value or formats it on a version ≥ 2.39.7, please add your exact n8n
version and browser language here — that's precisely what the team asked for to
reopen the investigation.

One separate heads-up: TCP/UDP ports max out at 65535, so a server cannot
actually listen on 100222 — worth double-checking the real port with your
provider. (A valid 5-digit port like 22222 or 65000 should of course still save
without a thousand separator — that display formatting is the genuine UI bug.)

If you're pinned on an older version and need the credential right now, bypass
the web form entirely via the CLI:

n8n export:credentials --id <cred-id> --decrypted --output=cred.json
# edit cred.json → "port": 22222
n8n import:credentials --input=cred.json

Then point your workflow at the re-imported credential, and delete/shred the
decrypted file — it contains your secrets.

Useful split-test for the team if this persists on ≥ 2.39.7: devtools → Network
→ save the credential → inspect the PATCH /rest/credentials/<id> payload. If the
browser already sends "100,222" or empty, the bug lives in the form control; if
it sends the correct number but the stored credential loses it, it's deeper in
serialization.
